title: Cumulative US IPA backfill from CMUdict single-pronunciation entries

source.name: CMU Pronouncing Dictionary (CMUdict)
source.license: Carnegie Mellon University CMUdict data license; see docs/licenses/CMUdict-DATA-LICENSE.txt
source.caveat: CMU states the dictionary may contain errors, omissions and inconsistencies. Only exact headword matches with one pronunciation and one primary stress were converted. The project conversion is broad GA IPA normalization, not an independent dictionary certification.

conversion.stress: 1=primary ˈ; 2=secondary ˌ; 0=unstressed; markers placed before syllable onset
conversion.syllabification: Conservative maximal-onset approximation using the project onset list; dots are display separators, not an independent syllable judgment.
conversion.exceptions: AH0→ə; ER0→ɚ; AH1/2→ʌ; ER1/2→ɝ; EH→e; AA→ɑ; AO→ɔ; standard consonant mappings.

excluded.policy: Leave phonetic.us blank until a lexical/editorial decision selects the correct US reading. The 91 unresolved records from the 1,063-headword base are inherited; Batch 012 exclusions are counted cumulatively.

notes: This is a cumulative ledger: v2.70.0 entries plus exact single-pronunciation Batch 012 entries.
Batch 012 additions with multiple CMUdict pronunciations, no exact entry, or failed conversion are left blank pending editorial review.
